sentences.en: No one is able to realize their dreams without persistence.
sentences.zh: 没有持之以恒的精神，没有人能够实现自己的梦想。

sentences.en: Ignorance is not bad faith. But persistence in ignorance is.
sentences.zh: 无知并不是罪过。但对无知的坚持才是。

sentences.en: It is nothing that a little persistence and ingenuity can't overcome.
sentences.zh: 没有什么是一点坚持和机智不能克服的。
